answer: Standing is a kernel that only sprouts when a stranger plants it: each epoch’s work must be requested by an established stranger — the stranger plants the kernel by asking for the work, and a quartz only forms when a stranger polishes it, while a timber only counts when a stranger measures it. A farm of a thousand fakes plants its own kernels: no stranger plants them, so they never sprout, and one epoch of self-planted work adds nothing.
